title: Evaluating a 4B open-weights local LLM for agentic DFT workflows: a literature reproducibility audit
abstract: arXiv:2608.29665v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic workflows in materials science relying on hosted commercial models face severe reproducibility, economic, and data-privacy constraints. To explore fully local agentic science, this work evaluates an open-weights Qwen3:4B model executing an autonomous scientific pipeline across varying hardware constraints. Applied to pentagonal two-dimensional materials, the system extracts parameters from unstructured text, translates them into density functional theory (DFT) inputs, and drives simulations to convergence under a strict neurosymbolic architecture where agents propose and deterministic code disposes. The workflow is guarded by verbatim text grounding and multi-pass inference unions to counteract hardware-induced structural collapse. translated_title: 评估40亿参数开源权重本地大语言模型用于智能体DFT工作流：一项文献可复现性审计
translated_abstract: 材料科学中依赖托管商业模型的智能体工作流面临严重的可复现性、经济性和数据隐私方面的限制。为了探索完全本地化的智能体科学，本工作评估了一个开源权重的Qwen3:4B模型在不同硬件约束下执行自主科学流水线的能力。该系统应用于五边形二维材料，从非结构化文本中提取参数，将其转化为密度泛函理论（DFT）输入，并在严格的神经符号架构下驱动模拟至收敛，其中智能体负责提出方案，确定性代码负责执行决策。该工作流通过逐字文本接地和多轮推理并集来防范硬件导致的结构崩溃。对照201条专家判断进行评估，该提取器实现了95.7%的精确率（95%置信区间为90.3–98.1%）和67.3%的召回率（59.8–74.0%），确保提取的参数严格符合事实。然而，精确……
tldr: 本研究评估了开源权重的Qwen3:4B本地大语言模型在五边形二维材料DFT智能体工作流中的表现，其参数提取达到95.7%的精确率，证明了在严格神经符号架构下完全本地化智能体科学工作流的可行性。
en_tdlr: This study evaluates a 4B open-weights local LLM (Qwen3:4B) for autonomous DFT workflows on pentagonal 2D materials, achieving 95.7% precision in parameter extraction and demonstrating the feasibility of fully local agentic science under a strict neurosymbolic architecture.
